programme.title: 怪奇「物」語 #2
programme.desc: 一些外貌最奇特的鳥類都是驚人的倖存者。一個快跑者、一個潮流指標、一個清道夫、一個花花公子和一個浪漫人士。這些有翅怪物證明除了外表,牠們還有很多東西令你詫異。

programme.title: 「擬人」動物 #5
programme.desc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略。參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐。

programme.title: 「擬人」動物 #6
programme.desc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲。發掘卷尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇。

programme.title: 野外紀事 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊。

programme.title: 深淵異形 #1
programme.desc: 熟悉各種海洋怪咖,從冰河時期到小行星撞擊,瞭解數十億年來的變化,如何塑造牠們的外表和技能。認識會釣魚的蛇蜥、跑行的鯊魚、爬樹的螃蟹等。

programme.title: 深淵異形 #2
programme.desc: 感受地球上一些最奇特的怪胎伙伴關係中古怪而溫馨的愛。深入觀察奇怪的動物,從鼓蝦到鰻狼魚,向牠們的海洋怪人朋友伸出援手,以確保能一起生存下來。

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #6
programme.desc: 準備觀看阿曼達博士冒險嘗試給野馬羚套上頸圈。然後,長尾猴發生騷亂,因此要追蹤藍冕狐猴- 阿藍。檢查一隻長了趾瘤的雕鴞,然後向即將返回野外的鱷魚希拉說再見。

programme.title: 動物朋友仔 #5
programme.desc: 本集《動物朋友仔》有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓。

programme.title: 「擬人」動物 #5
programme.desc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略。參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐。

programme.title: 魔幻水域的祕密 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿越充滿神秘色彩的湖泊世界,見證生命如何在極端環境中適應、存活並改變自己。觀察古老巨獸如鱷龜展現強大的力量,見證蜻蜓從幼蟲蛻變成成蟲的奇妙過程,並隨火烈鳥昂首闊步,勇敢地穿越燃燒、腐蝕性的水域,體驗生命的堅韌與美麗。

programme.desc: 隨著莉茲的腳步,探索北美自然界的神奇奇觀!在壯觀絕倫的珊瑚礁中暢泳,自由穿梭於色彩斑斕的海洋生態,挖掘遙遠時代的古老化石,並深入熱帶岸邊的密林,踏上充滿挑戰與驚喜的叢林之旅。在哥斯大黎加的海灘上,悄悄接近伺機而動的美洲虎,並與地球上最大型的鯊魚不期而遇,近距離感受牠們磅礴的氣勢。

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #1
programme.desc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然。日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖、生育和養育幼兒。

programme.title: 動物朋友仔 #6
programme.desc: 認識更多《動物朋友仔》,包括「牧場經理」巴克萊,一頭恰巧是馴馬天才的大丹犬。在非洲,一隻名為「雷神」的小狨猴迷戀兩隻年青獲救的獴。

programme.title: 深淵異形 #1
programme.desc: 熟悉各種海洋怪咖,從冰河時期到小行星撞擊,瞭解數十億年來的變化,如何塑造牠們的外表和技能。認識會釣魚的蛇蜥、跑行的鯊魚、爬樹的螃蟹等。

programme.title: 深淵異形 #2
programme.desc: 感受地球上一些最奇特的怪胎伙伴關係中古怪而溫馨的愛。深入觀察奇怪的動物,從鼓蝦到鰻狼魚,向牠們的海洋怪人朋友伸出援手,以確保能一起生存下來。

programme.title: 深藍巨獸 #4
programme.desc: 潛入紐西蘭奧克蘭附近的豪拉基灣,探索海洋生物的真正天堂。看一眼深海潛行者蝠鱝,欣賞海豚的搞怪動作,觀賞千變萬化的熱帶魚。

programme.title: 怪奇「物」語 #4
programme.desc: 世上到處都是令人毛骨悚然的爬行者,但不要被牠們的外表所迷惑 - 牠們都有厲害的生存技能。從裝死,到自發性移除尾巴,至足夠強壯來舉起牠們體重30倍的東西,這些昆蟲以其驚人的適應性征服世界。

programme.title: 野外紀事 #5 英普
programme.desc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變。北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨。

programme.title: 明猩學園 #3
programme.desc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性領袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓。見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險。

programme.title: 明猩學園 #4
programme.desc: 孤兒塞西亞患上瘧疾,團隊正努力遏止疾病在明猩學園中蔓延,並評估代母斯里幫助布米的計劃。一起看看紅毛猩猩媽媽達普特對女同學的積極影響;並目暏令人震驚的食物偷竊事件。

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #2
programme.desc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹、獅子、大守宮、烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能。

programme.title: 靈長大地 #1
programme.desc: 數百萬年前,被遺棄的生物發現自己被困在馬達加斯加崎嶇的海岸上,與大陸隔絕,新來者唯有進化。這是一個神奇的世界,稀有而獨特的動物完美地適應了牠們的熱帶世外桃源。

programme.title: 深藍巨獸 #5
programme.desc: 探索紐西蘭北部偏遠群島三王群島的奇異魔力。與寬吻海豚一起游泳,加入短尾黃貂魚的狩獵,感受一群食肉虎鯨出現時的緊張氣氛。

programme.title: 明猩學園 #3
programme.desc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性領袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓。見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險。

programme.title: 明猩學園 #4
programme.desc: 孤兒塞西亞患上瘧疾,團隊正努力遏止疾病在明猩學園中蔓延,並評估代母斯里幫助布米的計劃。一起看看紅毛猩猩媽媽達普特對女同學的積極影響;並目暏令人震驚的食物偷竊事件。

programme.title: 大白鯊的秘密
programme.desc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #1
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #2
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #1
programme.desc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #3
programme.desc: 動物嬰兒: 為了嬰兒免受極端情況、飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #4
programme.desc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一。從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #5
programme.desc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態。從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海。探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #3
programme.desc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統。在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活。

programme.title: 下一站: 緬甸
programme.desc: 《下一站: 緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #6
programme.desc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報。動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙。牠們必須學習覓食、保護家園、吸引配偶、養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #7
programme.desc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #8
programme.desc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #9
programme.desc: 爬行動物、兩棲動物、昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落——而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #10
programme.desc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰。這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #1
programme.desc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #2
programme.desc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #3
programme.desc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #4
programme.desc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #5
programme.desc: 人類、植物、動物、細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點: 死亡。我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #1
programme.desc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #2
programme.desc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力。從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #3
programme.desc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會。在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #4
programme.desc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺。但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷、最貧瘠的環境中繁衍。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #5
programme.desc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #1
programme.desc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #2
programme.desc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #3
programme.desc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。

programme.title: 哥斯大黎加: 大自然的面紗 #1
programme.desc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 哥斯大黎加: 大自然的面紗 #2
programme.desc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 哥斯大黎加: 大自然的面紗 #3
programme.desc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #1
programme.desc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭。變髒是工作的一部分。當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務。這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人。而且,總能忙裡偷閒。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #3
programme.desc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物。深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就。還有,努力無堅不摧。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #4
programme.desc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成、新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想。茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然。例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯。來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事。是時候告別韋札的家人。

programme.title: 納萊迪: 小象故事
programme.desc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #1
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #2
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #6
programme.desc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #7
programme.desc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠「交談」。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #8
programme.desc: 研究大自然動物中的交際花,揭示因同居而演化出的令人驚訝和難以置信的行為。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9
programme.desc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt tackles some weighty issues when the fattest parrot he has ever seen pays him a visit, in the sixth programme of the series Matt conducts an emergency caesarean to save the life of Penny the cat, and helps a swan which has been the victim of a brutal mugging

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In London, an underweight, heavily pregnant dog has been brought into the Blue Cross Animal hospital by its owner The mum to be needs emergency surgery to deliver her pups and because of her poor condition Inspector Annie Simmonds has been called in to investigate Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got monkey criminals, magic and mirrors, cheeky monkeys, monkey pals, banana loving primates, baby monkeys, monkeys vs cameras, monkeys out on the town, and monkeys acting like us humans

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: 全民情聖
programme.desc: 紐約「約會醫生」亞歷克斯赫金斯(韋史密夫飾)試圖吸引八卦專欄作家莎拉梅拉絲(伊娃曼德絲飾),同時他也指導害羞的阿爾伯特(凱文占士飾)如何贏得美麗女繼承人阿萊格拉科爾(琥珀瓦萊塔飾)的芳心。

programme.title: 3D 王牌小間諜
programme.desc: 時間所剩無多!退休間諜瑪莉莎(潔西卡·艾巴 飾)重出江湖,當一名反派威脅要讓全世界陷入冰封危機時,她必須再次出擊!在繼子女的協助與各種酷炫裝備的幫助下,他們展開一場與時間賽跑的精彩冒險——這是一部充滿動作與家庭樂趣的《3D 王牌小間諜》電影!

programme.title: 殺手不眨眼
programme.desc: 尼可拉斯在加拿大當牙醫。但當一位新鄰居搬進來卻讓他遇上麻煩,他知道那是人稱「鬱金香占美」的職業殺手- 占美圖德斯基。

programme.title: 小子難纏 2
programme.desc: 宮城先生得知父親快要死去,遂帶上丹尼爾一起去探望他。他回去後決定迎戰老對手;同時,丹尼爾無意中亦招惹了敵人。

programme.title: 世界大對戰
programme.desc: 在這場視覺上壯觀的動作冒險遊戲中,一群意想不到的前 80 年代電子遊戲冠軍挺身而出,拯救世界免於外星人入侵。

programme.title: 蒙面俠蘇洛2: 不朽傳奇
programme.desc: 即使嘗試保持低調,但對加州即將來臨的重大威脅,促使熱愛冒險的亞歷山卓穆瑞塔(班德拉斯飾)和他的妻子艾琳娜(薛達-鍾斯飾)採取行動。

programme.title: 小子難纏
programme.desc: 丹尼爾搬到一個新城鎮,他在當地受到一些精通空手道的男孩騷擾。他決心拜師學藝。而當宮城先生開始訓練他時,他發現這門功夫的博大精深。

programme.title: 命運好好玩
programme.desc: 一位工作狂建築師找到一個萬能遙控,能讓他快轉和快退到人生的不同部分。

programme.title: 超難搞先生
programme.desc: 一名火爆的鰥夫與新鄰居建立起改變他生活的不可思議友誼。

programme.title: 尖叫旅社 2
programme.desc: 超級超級超級老派的吸血鬼弗拉德來到酒店參加即興的家庭聚會,鬼靈精怪大酒店迎來超自然老派與酷感現代派的衝突。

programme.title: 全民情聖
programme.desc: 紐約「約會醫生」亞歷克斯赫金斯(韋史密夫飾)試圖吸引八卦專欄作家莎拉梅拉絲(伊娃曼德絲飾),同時他也指導害羞的阿爾伯特(凱文占士飾)如何贏得美麗女繼承人阿萊格拉科爾(琥珀瓦萊塔飾)的芳心。

programme.title: 迷走星球
programme.desc: 年輕的兩兄弟的房子神奇地衝入太空,他們繼而被捲入一場星際冒險。

programme.title: 新郎不是我
programme.desc: 一個愛上已訂婚女人的男人,在她邀請自己成為她的伴娘後試圖贏得她的芳心。

programme.title: 魔鬼剋星
programme.desc: 超自然現象愛好者艾比、愛琳、吉琳安和帕蒂開始捉鬼,她們意識到有人試圖在紐約市招魂來引發世界末日。

programme.title: 魔鬼剋星
programme.desc: 超自然現象愛好者艾比、愛琳、吉琳安和帕蒂開始捉鬼,她們意識到有人試圖在紐約市招魂來引發世界末日。

programme.title: 小子難纏 3
programme.desc: 身無分文的約翰克里斯遭到放逐,他試圖在一位越戰戰友的幫助下向丹尼爾和宮城報仇,這位戰友是一家有毒廢料處理公司的有錢老闆。

programme.title: 邁阿密風雲
programme.desc: 在《邁阿密風雲》中,由傑米・福克斯與柯林・法洛飾演的臥底警探深入毒品世界,在危險、誘惑與犯罪中周旋。這部風格鮮明、緊張刺激的作品重新演繹經典影集,同時由鞏俐聯袂主演。

programme.title: 鐵皮人一部
programme.desc: 重新詮釋自李曼·法蘭克·鮑姆經典作品《綠野仙蹤》。

programme.desc: 突然出現在亞連面前的林克監察官表示自己是奉教團之命前來監視。亞連對林克所說的話感到動搖,他透過玻璃窗戶看到奏者的影子映照在自己身後。另一邊,利娜莉遇到魯貝里亞,童年記憶因此被喚醒。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #1

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #99

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #1
programme.desc: 喜歡強者,對弱者沒興趣的孤獨不良高中生櫻遙,為了爬上不良學校風鈴高中的頂點,從鎮「外」來到這裡。櫻在商店街從混混手中救下的少女琴葉,請他到波特斯咖啡廳吃飯作為報答,卻直言他無法爬上頂點。氣憤的櫻在隨後了解到她話中的真意及「風鈴的現狀」。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #22
programme.desc: 在出發前往宮崎前,阿奎亞與佳奈一同出門購物。在阿奎亞周到的安排下,佳奈開心得手足無措…。另一方面,失去揪出父親這個目標的阿奎亞則是向小茜坦白說出…

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #23
programme.desc: 睽違10多年,阿奎亞再度踏上過去吾郎與紗理奈生活過、亦是阿奎亞與露比的出生之地的宮崎,阿奎亞回顧著吾郎的人生軌跡。另一方面,心裡一直深藏對吾郎心意的露比卻…。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #1
programme.desc: 喜歡強者,對弱者沒興趣的孤獨不良高中生櫻遙,為了爬上不良學校風鈴高中的頂點,從鎮「外」來到這裡。櫻在商店街從混混手中救下的少女琴葉,請他到波特斯咖啡廳吃飯作為報答,卻直言他無法爬上頂點。氣憤的櫻在隨後了解到她話中的真意及「風鈴的現狀」。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #4
programme.desc: 快跑啊!超可愛的貓咪來了!時間來到21世紀某時期,全世界都被貓咪佔據,有一種病毒會把接觸到貓的人都變成貓,讓全世界爆發貓化大流行,人只要被貓蹭過就會變成貓。人類究竟能否壓抑住想摸貓的衝動,在滿是貓咪的世界中存活下來呢?

programme.title: 地球大神祕(國語)
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:所以,不要憂慮! 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話: 「最後,我想講嘅就係,主令我改變。」

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-婚姻的藍圖
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛……助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:李盛林牧師-出埃及記
programme.desc: 前無去路,後有追兵,憑信心過紅海。 雲柱火柱日夜引路,天降嗎哪為持生命。 流浪曠野四十年,以色列人用血﹑淚﹑性命寫成的感人見證! 今天,對你有甚麼啟示呢? 李盛林牧師與你深入探討《出埃及記》中的主要資訊,讓信徒掌握此書卷之意義,並如何落實應用於現今世代。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」- 以巴戰爭與聖經預言
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蔡錦圖博士-小先知書的大意義
屬靈教室:李盛林牧師-出埃及記
programme.desc: 前無去路,後有追兵,憑信心過紅海。 雲柱火柱日夜引路,天降嗎哪為持生命。 流浪曠野四十年,以色列人用血﹑淚﹑性命寫成的感人見證! 今天,對你有甚麼啟示呢? 李盛林牧師與你深入探討《出埃及記》中的主要資訊,讓信徒掌握此書卷之意義,並如何落實應用於現今世代。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:所以,不要憂慮! 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 程蒙恩長老-主耶穌的「喜怒哀樂」
programme.desc: 究竟我們可以怎樣在生活和事奉裡討主的喜悅?論到《聖經》四福音書,記載了不少耳熟能詳關於耶穌的生平事蹟。程蒙恩長老提醒我們,可以從這些記載看到主耶穌喜歡什麼,我們學習喜歡主耶穌所歡喜的事物,就可以討主喜悅。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 十一娘在仙綾閣授課之事被徐令宜發現，他感慨其善良，命人暗中保護。徐令宜向皇上上報霉米出自軍中，靖遠侯只能斬除黨羽以自保。為爭寵，羅大太太要琥珀勾引徐令宜，琥珀不想背叛十一娘，十一娘也一心要保護琥珀。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 李家鼎與一班順德廚藝學生在鏡頭前各展刀法，鼎爺切出「蘿蔔網」，大顯功架！香港人吃慣茶市美食糯米雞，鼎爺返回廚房卻帶來截然不同的「古法糯米雞」，將糯米、臘味等惹味材料釀入鮮雞烹調，炮製既傳統又新奇的廣東風味。番薯品種五花八門，鼎爺聯同阿譚走進街市，暢談挑選優質番薯之道。鼎爺又以自製湯丸和糖不甩伴吃番薯糖水，藉着不同口感帶來香甜享受。他選用黃肉、紅肉番薯、黑蔗糖一起煲糖水，配搭到底暗藏甚麼美味玄機？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 即將踏進新一年，最緊要身心健康。精神科醫生細說「精神健康急救」的概念，涵蓋哪五個範疇？受情緒或精神困擾的人士，生理、心理方面均會出現症狀，並影響日常生活。身邊人可嘗試「3T」方法給予幫助，同時要有甚麼避忌？鄧達智手持魚竿、桶子埋岸落船，只為款待大王、菲比一頓海鮮盛宴做準備。以為只有龍蝦、龍躉等海鮮是主角？大王稱讚在旁的醬汁也美味非常！「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐炮製惹味菜式「果皮豆豉香茅蝦」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 吃辣可會導致胃潰瘍？嘉賓彭金滿與湯兆昇兩位博士，從嗜辣地方的飲食文化分析，先得一分。腸胃肝臟科專科醫生細述胃潰瘍的主要成因；不認輸的戴祖儀、鄺潔楹竟繼續「死撐」！醫生亦解說酒會導致胃潰瘍的原因；祖儀、湯博士分別嘗試做出可減少胃酸倒流的睡姿，原來側睡的方向都有影響。幽門螺旋菌會引致胃部不適，而名為「腸化生」的變異，更有機會是惡疾先兆。還有中醫師帶來適合寒、熱底人士的健脾養胃湯水，並淺談入湯食材功效。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#26粵PG
programme.desc: 駿昇想到一個計劃，坦言如無效便沒有反擊希望。Derek告知歐陽杰存款有異，柏義即向歐陽杰查問，發現是個局。柏義與駿昇發生槍戰，冠一帶林磊逃走時被天龍阻截，冠一只好持槍與他對峙。駿昇顧念與林磊的友情，要求醫生全力醫好林磊。駿昇帶同林磊及醫生團隊向董事會動議罷免柏義主席之位，柏義無話可說。天龍取笑柏義的計劃不完美才失敗，兩人決裂，聲言要各自對付駿昇及冠一。其西碰到兆良的女友有新男伴，要正花多加小心。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 城崎生日將至，笹山計劃偷偷為她辦生日會，小丸子為送什麼生日禮物給城崎而煩惱。藤木原來只比城崎遲一天生日，小丸子因為說過希望天天都能參加朋友的生日會，無奈之下唯有替藤木慶祝生日。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 這次只有三位小兵來到零食廠，因此孤身作戰的薯片小兵，在「廠長話」環節有額外一次容許出錯機會。熱身賽全員零失誤，但踏入正式比賽的第一個指令，就已有人犯錯？推地壺收集食材遊戲，雖然未能達到蚌蚌公主加碼收集第三款食材的要求，但兩隊都以四個地壺完成任務。輪到運送雪糕關卡，曲奇隊分工合作，做出十六個雪糕球的成績。薯片小兵一人走四趟溶化之橋，第三次運送時卻大意失手，最後一輪要挑戰六球才有機會扳平，他能做到嗎？

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿渡一行人來到一個燈光通明的城鎮，詎料竟是由阿翔和麥格搭建的「懲罰遊戲村」。兩人希望拉攏阿驅加入，但後者不從，經歷一連串懲罰遊戲後，雙方最終以魔神對決，阿翔和麥格亦說出心底話。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: RSV即呼吸道合胞病毒，與流感病徵相似，但死亡率就比流感高得多，其中嬰幼兒是高危一族，有甚麼方法可以減少感染？卵巢癌是婦女癌症中排第六位的致命殺手，現時相關的治療方案有甚麼選擇？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 母親長期住院，其子受託以提款卡提款時發現母親戶口被凍結，持授權文件要求銀行解凍，卻遭拒？某拍賣會被指涉及假競投，連競投安排、價值連城的拍賣品都疑似造假？兼職特約演員大揭受邀加入拍賣會觀眾群組，並「做媒」參與拍賣會內幕。唐樓大維修後不到一年，就出現天花滲水、石屎剝落等問題，據悉受相鄰大廈滲水而波及？《中年好聲音4》港區再有五燈選手誕生，唱將們分享直接晉級感受。另會一探外語導遊如何體現旅遊業好客之道。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2713粵
programme.desc: 龔燁等人偶然發現力蓮打算於12月30日出埠前赴某島，並查到島上有一道每隔廿五年才開啟的門，這年正值開門之期。據稱走過此門就能洗清一生罪孽，眾人懷疑力蓮是要趕在閉門前清洗罪孽。眾人有所發現，思疑力蓮暗藏不可告人的秘密，於是暗中查探。另一邊廂，力王重遇故人，獲告知力蓮曾犯下多宗大罪，遂與力蓮對質，但她一概否認。龔燁等人向力王提出力蓮的各項罪證，力王決意阻止她洗脫罪孽，務要逼她面對過錯……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#11粵PG
programme.desc: 兩名嫌疑人的口供都指向阿肯，而且背後有個名叫安娜的女人，何浩輝分析，安娜的背後就是外國基金，目的是通過黑社會去擾亂香港的社會秩序，從而影響到香港的金融市場，現在不僅要盯緊阿肯，更要引出安娜。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#7粵普PG
programme.desc: 一笑與未然激戰後放他走，但隨歌抓住未然；寧非質問未然殺一笑原因，一笑出現與二人恩斷義絕，寧非暈倒，凌峰稱有地方能救寧非，一笑要帶寧非去求醫；隨歌帶荀翔見平城，莊后否認刺殺與莊家有關，隨歌與平城針鋒相對

programme.title: 尚品花膠專門店呈獻:東張今年大件事2025粵
programme.desc: 香港街道人如潮湧，路上擦身而過，本應相安無事，四位「猛人」敲腳婆婆、伸拳姐、踩腳姐及飛腳姐，卻為途人帶來滋擾，甚至潛在傷害。節目組重新尋找她們的蹤影，有人死性不改，有人變得「溫柔」？一宗銀行地庫保險箱水浸個案，揭出失去樓契正本的嚴重後果，陸續有更多誤購無契樓的報道，「東張」宗旨是提醒準業主們免招損失！演唱會盛事連連，同時惹來騙徒「撈油水」，這集回顧涉款千萬的內部飛騙局來龍去脈，警惕樂迷購票要小心。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
名媛望族#12粵PG
programme.desc: 爾嫣考驗子君真心，準備了含有水銀的茶，子君同意飲下。卓萬命啟燁跟進政府工程；卓萬知啟燁犯錯，要他想辦法解決。啟燁帶爾熹到妓寨，木水聽到啟燁說阿玉手上有心形疤痕，想起小由妹妹的特徵上前阻止，與啟燁交惡。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#6粵
programme.desc: 蕙婷做事三分鐘熱度，她又要學鋼琴，有朋花了三萬多元買鋼琴給她，可惜蕙婷又告放棄，並要改學泰拳，擅自交三千元學費。有朋為免她再半途而廢，決定陪她一起學。蕙婷再度半途而廢，有義與溢滿踢爆有朋學拳亦沒恆心。

programme.title: 街坊廚神舌戰新台韓粵
programme.desc: 主持和嘉賓曾志偉喝湯進補！人參雞湯、大豆芽湯飯等，都列入「舌戰」湯物清單。韓、港的炒年糕，口味可有分別？眾人還在香港品嚐足料泡飯及老火靚湯。「學廚PK賽」，小儀能否憑韓式「辣牛肉粉絲湯」延續勝利？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵

高朋滿座#7粵
programme.desc: 藥房熟客漸被宇生搶去，高慶不滿，妙喜被無理取鬧，提出讓高慶當家。高慶成為當家，購入多項「特價產品」，高家眾人苦不堪言。眾人提議他參加瑜珈班分散他視線，不過其後眾人發現高慶為家中添置數箱過期的罐頭乾貨。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#17粵普
programme.desc: 區少夫人跟二娘與十一娘搭話，十一娘言語犀利地譏諷區少夫人跟二娘，令徐太夫人很滿意；令宜做噩夢，十一娘向臨波打聽令宜的心結；十一娘跟簡師父提起區少夫人袖口的繡樣是重要線索，決定扮成丫鬟隨簡師父去區府。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺與阿譚清早來到逢簡河畔，探究順德河鮮肥美鮮甜的因由。二人吃過馳名順德魚粥後意猶未盡，鼎爺選用大魚魚頭，炮製據稱有去頭風療效的「川芎白芷天麻燉魚頭湯」，箇中美味連阿譚亦食指大動！及後烹調的「荷葉蒸雞」同樣用料十足，除了用上蟲草花、冬菇、雲耳、紅棗，鼎爺還特別以乾荷葉與新鮮荷葉包着雞項蒸煮，成品究竟有多滋味？挑選刀具要講究，去除魚腥、泥味亦有學問，鼎爺於示範期間逐一公開他的私房烹飪心得。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 化妝前護膚、化妝品選擇、卸妝後護膚原來都大有學問，醫生分享專業意見，助大家保持肌膚健康。有指旅行時特別容易誘發皮膚過敏，醫生細說箇中原因，並提供應對暗瘡、皮膚黯沉等肌膚問題的方法。透過體重與身高，可計算自己可會超重，標準數值為何？外科醫生亦會詳析生活型態調整、藥物治療、介入治療等體重控制方案，還帶來培養健康生活習慣的建議。「睇餸食飯」環節，保哥呈獻一道「鴻運脆雞配柚子汁」，既惹味又開胃。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 多吃蔬果仍會便秘？「大王」安德尊與焦浩軒，林穎彤與狄易達兩組嘉賓都帶出水、油對排便的重要，營養師講解兩者的作用。排便狀況與腸道的好、壞菌息息相關，甚麼食物含有益腸道的益生原？放屁是正常生理反應，屁的氣味反映身體狀況，腸胃肝臟科專科醫生解釋不同屁味的成因。甚麼顏色的糞便反映可能患上大腸癌？大王一組為了突破零的局面，無所不用其極，終於靠反駁成功得分。另外，還會帶來一款以奇亞籽製作的健腸布甸。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#27粵PG
programme.desc: 駿昇感謝眾人為他重奪娛樂城主席之位，送上禮物並當眾向月華求婚。天龍得知婚訊，大發脾氣，柔紫質問天龍有否愛過她。月華及駿昇的婚禮上，天龍持槍掃射，月華甘為駿昇擋槍。冠一追着天龍到蔣廬，天龍誓要殺死冠一，想逃離時卻發現秘道被封。正花過馬路時失神，兆良出手救之，並感謝她與冠一讓他明白為愛人犧牲之道。冠一在老人院裝上炸彈，希望炸死柏義，柏義逃離現場並與冠一扭打，冠一遭棚架壓傷，柏義終等到處決冠一的時機……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 臨近歲晚，小丸子從丸尾口中得知「收爐」的概念，於是決定隨爸爸去釣魚，吃頓好的去收爐。小丸子收拾時三心兩意，結果錯過百惠的表演，她把一切歸咎於煩惱，決定在除夕夜去撞鐘以驅散煩惱。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子打算儲錢，但每次一收到零用錢便馬上花光，於是想到一個辦法，便是把錢藏起來再把事情忘記。爺爺想到自己老是寵愛小丸子一個，冷落了姐姐，於是千方百計去寵愛姐姐，卻落得兩面不是人。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 香港水域擁有豐富海洋生態，吸引不少潛水愛好者下海探索。本集「Kids’ Notes」邀請海洋保育團體的兩位代表，引領大家認識本港海洋的魅力。浮潛可視為探索海洋的入門體驗，已能欣賞到珊瑚、魔鬼魚等有趣的海洋生物，參與活動時有甚麼要注意？嘉賓提醒水下可能會出現「鬼網」，有機會對海洋生物、潛水員、船隻造成傷害，這卻是人類所製造？嘉賓還分享如何為清除鬼網出力，並介紹常見的海洋垃圾，也呼籲大家共同守護海洋。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 瑪蘿帶大家去可以知道世界真相的地方，誰知目的地竟是炎上達的家。眾人跳進湖中，去到另一個世界，並在那裡遇見玄武、白虎、鳳凰和瑪蘿的弟弟月讀。月讀揭開瑪蘿的真正身分，令眾人感到震驚。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2714粵
programme.desc: 加入接龍餐飲部的Venus銳意「釣金龜」，並鎖定Joe為新目標。Joe與壯及餐飲部眾人開會時，偶然發現一件披肩，Joe打算購買同款送贈天娥。Venus冒認披肩為己物，借花敬佛，怎料披肩原是壯親手編織，本欲送贈Elaine，兩人因此結怨，展開惡鬥。Elaine充當和事老，Venus遂設法逼壯講和，並與他達成共識，在感情事上互相幫忙。除夕夜，Venus向Joe展開攻勢，壯則向Elaine表白，詎料……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#12粵PG
programme.desc: 時間臨近週一，高層施壓儘快破案，何浩輝提示陳耀揚要從關女士處突破。陳耀揚聽取建議，用林蔚言拍到的姜、韋二人的照片攻破了關女士心房，關女士說分手費是姜議員提出的，承諾到手後一人一半，並且二人還簽了合同。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 鳳隨歌公然頂撞鳳平城，並抗旨提起母親，被惱怒的平城下令回府反省，戲陽大婚大典前的祭祖大典改由二皇子亞獻。付一笑追問面具人究竟是誰，但夏靜石避重就輕，轉移話題求一笑回到他身邊，一笑心灰意冷，決然離開。

programme.title: 尚品花膠專門店呈獻:東張今年大件事2025粵
programme.desc: 本年「東張」報道過不少騙案，箇中的情騙令人印象深刻，一於綜合騙徒常用套路。不同的情騙，有兩位事主更可謂網民心目中的「最佳女主角」？熟齡女子因網戀「帥男」而與家人反目，報道播出後引來外界大量批評，據悉當事人對這些負評疑有不滿……曾深信跟「劉天王」對話的婆婆，則拆解受訪時金句「夠膽呃我就夠膽畀你」的背後信念。這集亦回顧補習社少女職員遭性騷擾的個案。主持更藉節目感謝觀眾支持，同時卻要為某些報料人致歉？

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
香港旅遊發展局呈獻:香港跨年倒數粵
programme.desc: 迎接2026的香港跨年倒數活動，在中環遮打道行人專用區舉行，國際組合Air Supply矚目登場，本地歌手馮允謙及雲浩影亦會現場獻唱。此外，中環共八幢建築物外牆，會以巨型倒數時鐘及光影圖案，跟大眾一起倒數，並上演以「新希望、新開始」為主題的光影表演，向市民與旅客傳遞正能量與祝福，讓大家攜手邁進新一年。

programme.title: 鐘鳴元旦 福佑香江2026
programme.desc: 《鐘鳴元旦 福佑香港2026》會於2025年除夕夜在志蓮淨苑舉行，高僧、善信齊聚一堂，以莊嚴的誦偈與叩鐘儀式迎接新一年。午夜零點時分，鐘聲悠揚響徹，寓意辭舊迎新，祈願本港在新的一年繁榮安定、市民安康。大眾於一片祥和氛圍下迎接2026，並寄望新歲吉祥如意、福佑香江。

programme.title: 肥龍過江粵PG
programme.desc: 模範警員朱福龍因未婚妻悔婚而自暴自棄，變成一個200磅的胖子。上司只好派他前往日本執行簡單的押送疑犯任務，可惜疑犯卻逃跑了，但失蹤的疑犯卻被發現陳屍在東京灣。為完成任務，朱福龍聯同一眾朋友，協力查出真相!

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 脫牙會增加認知障礙風險？嘉賓區永權、陳庭欣、吳幸美、蔡康年分析時都現嚴重「語障」，還是請牙科醫生講解咀嚼過程與認知功能的關係，腦神經科專科醫生亦會講解認知障礙症的患病原因。即場做一項認知小測試，題目中的動物圖案已令嘉賓迷惘？講到柏金遜症的病徵，康年突然「拋書包」，有料到！兩種「腦」毛病有何差別？再派出庭欣與幸美進行柏金遜症小測試。中醫亦帶來一款健腦益智湯水，嘉賓辨別藥材同時，亦了解天麻的補腦功效。

programme.title: 巴打秘景遊粵
programme.desc: 「巴打」跟隨「地膽」梁敏巧深入沙頭角，揭開其神秘面貌。一行人先到訪「沙頭角阿Sa、阿嬌」，試用鐵鑊炮製炒米粉，還趁機學習客家話。位處禁區的中英街，豎立了界石標示香港和深圳的分界。新樓街唐樓群是二級歷史建築，滿載舊香港氛圍。眾人與街坊打成一片，即興舉行常識問答比賽！乘船往荔枝窩，順道眺望深圳鹽田港。巴打尋找客家生活體驗村，感受傳統鄉村生活。在夜空下互訴心事，三位大男孩細談演藝路上的辛酸，不禁感觸。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵

programme.title: 錦心似玉#18粵普

programme.title: 雙祥見粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 進入新的一年，不少人都會訂立新目標，但根據「經驗」，有部份人會難於完成新年所訂立的大計。臨床心理學家提供訂立目標的建議，並講述如何維持動力去執行。相信「身體健康」是大部份人的其中一個目標，今集亦請到心臟科醫生，提供愛護心臟的小貼士，當中包括要脫離肥胖、改善飲食、持續定期進行中高強度運動，醫生還有甚麼護心秘訣可以分享？新一年以美食慰勞自己，「睇餸食飯」傅季馨提出用「焗釀蟹蓋」為新年作個好開始。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#28粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)冠一向駿昇交代柏義最新情況，駿昇勸他盡快返港陪正花。正花因擔心胎兒早產，徹夜難眠。冠一與同門慶功時，收到正花來電，但傳來竟是兆良的聲音，他以正花及胎兒要脅冠一在二十四小時內從獄中救出柏義。冠一助柏義逃獄，柏義卻不肯透露正花在哪裏，眾同門偷偷地去救正花，卻誤入兆良的陷阱。柏義迫冠一玩死亡遊戲，並直播給眾人觀看；林磊趁駿昇看直播時，突然想把駿昇從高處推下去；兆良則準備殺死正花腹中胎兒……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子開生日會，媽媽勒令只能邀請五人出席，更指定其中三人為丸尾、花輪和小翠，令小丸子大為頭痛。小丸子想養禾雀，費盡心思終於說服父母，誰知禾雀售罄，小丸子不願等，於是買了十姊妹回家。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 到了出新茶的季節，一向對茶味有要求的小丸子迫不及待叫媽媽買新茶，並到小玉家裡品嚐她們家嘅新茶。學校參觀日將至，小丸子企圖隱瞞卻被媽媽發現，最後只能認命，盡力在課堂上作出好表現。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，這次需要用上瑜伽墊、兩塊瑜伽磚，來配合做運動。將腿部屈曲、壓低，稍作熱身，就可正式訓練。躺下後用單腳腳掌舉高瑜伽磚，再做手肘碰膝蓋等動作，能保持穩定不弄跌瑜伽磚嗎？及後要用大腿及前臂夾緊瑜伽磚，再將雙腳輪流伸直，都有助強化核心肌群。為了訓練下肢穩定性，要準備好雙腳長時間抬起並呈現屈曲90度的狀態，還有腿部伸直、跨過瑜伽磚的練習，對改善腿型有一定幫助。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 最近，陽葵總是跟阿紡一起，這讓美月有些寂寞。與此同時，學生會正調查能夠使出人氣螢光幻彩變身的阿紡。為測試阿紡的實力，學生會更邀請美月與阿紡對壘。然而，美月擔心一旦輸了，陽葵會被阿紡奪去……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 人靠衣裝，肥瘦各有漂亮之處，可以說是見人見智，但大部分人都覺得瘦比較吸引，所以減肥成為不少人的終生事業。新聞掏寶和大家重溫1995年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#13粵
programme.desc: 蔣坤拒絕了安娜搜集香港富豪家庭地址的要求，並且表示不會再參與EGM的事情，安娜告訴他恐怕沒有那麼容易。邵子俊幫助梁婉婷說服了梁母，梁母同意婉婷留在警隊。何浩輝將調回前線的消息告訴蔡卓欣，蔡卓欣反應冷淡

programme.title: 毒舌大狀粵PG
programme.desc: 大律師林涼水以毒舌見稱，他在處理一宗全城關注的虐兒案時，因一時自負大意而令無辜被告人蒙受17年冤獄。自此身敗名裂的林涼水只好以「旺角價錢，中環質素」的貼地服務為平民百姓打官司，直至一次翻案機會出現

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
名媛望族#13粵
programme.desc: 卓萬低調迎娶子君，與子君到上海旅行結婚。子君望浩頤接受自己，浩頤坦言沒可能與她做朋友。卓萬帶子君到紗廠，向她說出心願。爾嫣回娘家，蘊善擔心她失寵，影響爾熹。卓萬知懿芳欺侮子君，要替她出氣，子君卻阻止。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 進入新的一年，不少人都會訂立新目標，但根據「經驗」，有部份人會難於完成新年所訂立的大計。臨床心理學家提供訂立目標的建議，並講述如何維持動力去執行。相信「身體健康」是大部份人的其中一個目標，今集亦請到心臟科醫生，提供愛護心臟的小貼士，當中包括要脫離肥胖、改善飲食、持續定期進行中高強度運動，醫生還有甚麼護心秘訣可以分享？新一年以美食慰勞自己，「睇餸食飯」傅季馨提出用「焗釀蟹蓋」為新年作個好開始。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#28粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)冠一向駿昇交代柏義最新情況，駿昇勸他盡快返港陪正花。正花因擔心胎兒早產，徹夜難眠。冠一與同門慶功時，收到正花來電，但傳來竟是兆良的聲音，他以正花及胎兒要脅冠一在二十四小時內從獄中救出柏義。冠一助柏義逃獄，柏義卻不肯透露正花在哪裏，眾同門偷偷地去救正花，卻誤入兆良的陷阱。柏義迫冠一玩死亡遊戲，並直播給眾人觀看；林磊趁駿昇看直播時，突然想把駿昇從高處推下去；兆良則準備殺死正花腹中胎兒……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#7粵
programme.desc: 藥房熟客漸被宇生搶去，高慶不滿，妙喜被無理取鬧，提出讓高慶當家。高慶成為當家，購入多項「特價產品」，高家眾人苦不堪言。眾人提議他參加瑜珈班分散他視線，不過其後眾人發現高慶為家中添置數箱過期的罐頭乾貨。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#18粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘潛入區府尋找線索險被發現，幸得林世顯解圍，原來他是區家二公子。十一娘為母親做法事，蓮房心虛受驚，意外暴露她與元娘之死有關。區勵行為了破壞衛國公和徐令宜的關係，設計讓王煜看上衛國公的義女蓮頌。

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 麥長青帶同檸檬汁，說要去除依附在地毯上的頑固紅酒漬，牆上的筆漬又怎樣去除？不同品牌的啤酒樽蓋也有21個鋸齒，此數字有甚麼玄機？啤酒有特異功能，可在植物及人頭上起作用！巧妙折曲衣架，輕易變身萬用掛架！

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 冰凍汽水人人愛，忘了把汽水放雪櫃？來一盆冰水，30秒便可「急凍」它！飲料倒出來有時會濺得滿桌都是，掌握簡單技巧便輕鬆解決。女士也可極速換燈膽、鑽牆兼不傷手？留意香香示範！倒數小小麵包袋夾的實用五強。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐(完)
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: The Traveller: At the End of the Night
programme.desc: Laurent, the brother of Captain Kandinsky, gets into an argument with a young woman who accuses him of harassment. All suspicion inevitably falls on Laurent when she is discovered dead the next day, and it is up to Kandinsky to clear his brother’s name.

programme.title: Particles
programme.desc: As winter sets in and P.A. sees the world shifting around him, he starts to observe strange phenomena in the environment. The changes are imperceptible at first, but gradually his whole world seems to be on the brink.

programme.title: Adventures In The Land Of Asha
programme.desc: After 9-year-old Jules is banned from school because of his rare skin disease, his greatest wish is to be cured. He meets a mysterious new friend, Asha, after his dog runs away into the forest. Together, they go on an adventure to find a cure for him.

programme.title: The Traveller: The House in the Wind
programme.desc: After the mysterious death of the Traveler, Captain Yann Kandinsky returns to the Ardennes, where he reopens a decade-old murder case that may be tied to two multiple unsolved killings.

programme.title: For A Moment, Forever
programme.desc: A young popstar overwhelmed by fame meets a troubled ex-rocker teaching music to adolescents at a therapy centre. Both longing for love, they get closer as affection for music connects them, but shall they overcome the burdens of his past?

programme.title: Forever
programme.desc: Childhood friends, Nina and Hugo chose different paths in life. Years later, Hugo returns to his hometown unbeknownst to him, the day before Nina's wedding. Events on the wedding day throw them back together and they embark on a new adventure.

programme.title: Open Door
programme.desc: Rudina embarks on a road trip with her pregnant sister Elma back to their Albanian hometown. However, Elma is unmarried, and they need to find someone to play the part of her husband in order not to anger their traditional father.

programme.title: My Killer Buddy
programme.desc: Denni is 10 years old and has a mission, to save his mother from his father’s violence. For this reason he devises an infallible plan: he will have him killed by someone who kills people for a living, a super-killer.

programme.title: For The Birds
programme.desc: Irma is a tomboy who believes independence is the only form of freedom. Then she meets Sampie, a charming rugby player with a heart of gold and oh-so-soft hands who sweeps her right off her feet to the altar, but not before she teaches him a thing or two.

programme.title: The Traveller: The Valley of Fear
programme.desc: In the Basque Country, Captain Yann Kandinsky investigates the disappearance of a young bookseller whose case mirrors a murder from twenty years earlier. All evidence points to the same man—Yves Cesnoz, convicted of the first crime—but Kandinsky believes the real killer is still at large.

programme.title: Patchwork Family
programme.desc: Christian is a divorced father who can only see his young daughter Vanessa every other weekend. When he meets the single mother Christine and decides to participate in a summer TV show, his whole life is turned upside down.

programme.title: The Bride In Red
programme.desc: In a bid to scam their guests off their gifts of cash, Roberta and Leòn enlist the help of Roberta’s non-conformist aunt to stage a fake wedding . However, they need to navigate the obstacle that is Roberta’s eccentric family for the scheme to work.

programme.title: Khutulun: The Wrestling Princess (OTO)

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Loch Ness, Scotland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters head to Scotland in search of the Loch Ness Monster, but Grandmaster Glitch plans to catch Nessie first, if only his Grimbler was up to the job.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Calypso
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends enjoy various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song... all except the mysterious Pretzel.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Tickle Crabs
programme.desc: When Dad brings a pair of tenacious tickle crabs home from the beach, nowhere in the house is safe! His only hope of escaping their tickles is with help from his true love.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Tiger Cubs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve in India on a baby animal mission to track down a female tiger and her new born cubs. Along the way, our team outwit a sloth that strays dangerously close to the den where the cubs are resting.

programme.title: Dog Squad (S1) - Mission: Cheese Sandwiches
programme.desc: Tom and Meagaidh visit a school to show the children how a Search and Rescue dog works.

programme.title: Steve and Aneeshwar Go Wild (S1) - Barn Owl and Bats
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar give fruit bats some breakfast and watch them fly around in the dark. The next animal they meet is the barn owl, which lives in a very similar way to the bats.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Babysitting Badge
programme.desc: King Tiger is called in to look after the Squirrels, as he has a Babysitting Badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The A Cappella Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are inspired to learn how to sing a cappella style.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Topiary Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee practicing his impressive Topiary skills and are keen to try it.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Eiffel Tower, France
programme.desc: Four adventure-seeking superheroes explore places all around the world. The Go Jetters try to fix the Eiffel tower after Grandmaster Glitch breaks it while using it as a TV aerial.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Go Jet Academy: Birthday Surprise
programme.desc: The Go Jetters plan a surprise birthday party for Ubercorn!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Shankar's Makeover
programme.desc: There's a fancy dress competition on the railways and while Thomas and the others are excited, Shankar doesn't want to join in.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Rainbow's Niece
programme.desc: Sarah's new colour wheel reminds Rainbow that he has not seen his niece in a while.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Duck Hotel
programme.desc: Duck wins a trip for two to a rather exciting hotel, and he finds that he settles in much quicker than Sarah.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Treasure
programme.desc: Morris and Pearl have lost one of their medals in the canal. Stanley fishes it out only have the complete collection dropped in. Stanley dons a diver's suit and goes after them.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Pumpkin
programme.desc: Stanley must keep Myrtle's pumpkin safe from Speedy the snail. He builds a series of obstacles and defences to protect it from the tenacious Speedy who tests Stanley's ingenuity.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Cousin Flora
programme.desc: Monty becomes confused when playing with his cousin Flora when he learns that they play differently to one another.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to Discover Somewhere New
programme.desc: JoJo wants to go somewhere new, so Gran Gran takes her to see new places. JoJo realises that even when you think you know somewhere, there are always new places to discover.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Betty's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun trying out games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn't always enjoy playing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Hat Badge
programme.desc: King Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up to the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Loch Ness, Scotland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters head to Scotland in search of the Loch Ness Monster, but Grandmaster Glitch plans to catch Nessie first, if only his Grimbler was up to the job.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Banana
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, it's Banana revealing an astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, I've Got a Secret.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Grapes
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, it's the spectacular acrobatic grapes working together to perform the most difficult structures to perfection.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Tin Can Games
programme.desc: It's the Tin Can Games and Evil Pea wants to win the Tin Can Trophy. She cheats in the final race by putting a magnet on Supertato's back to stop him from going super fast.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Tablet Takeover
programme.desc: The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they've found. When they're not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Bouncing
programme.desc: Laa-Laa and Po drive in the Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup. They take turns on the Tubby Bouncy. Tinky Winky and Dipsy arrive and they have a go at bouncing too!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father's death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu serves his triad society loyally and tries to live a respectable life, but over time his good intentions lead him to an all-out gang war with a startling conclusion.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government officer heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route, he encounters &amp; recruits a skilled swordsman as a bodyguard. They then meet a fleeing bride and her maid who asked to join them for protection. When the group reach a ruined temple however, a gang of assassins appear and attack them...

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr Lo has three sons, Leung, Fay and Kung; and a daughter-in-law, Eliza. While they seem like a normal family, their relationships need mending. Leung and Fay play a prank on their brother Kung on his birthday by falsely claiming that he has won the lottery. This sets off a chain reaction of funny mishaps that finally brings the family together.

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: The Truth
programme.desc: Orphaned lawyer Raymond Lau once helped clear hooker Lan of murder charges, not knowing that Lan is his mother. When a corrupt cop blackmails Lan with Raymond's identity, she kills him out of desperation. When Raymond is enlisted again to defend Lan, he uncovers the secret that she has been hiding about their relationship for years.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: Model from Hell
programme.desc: Anna, an exceptional student in a modelling school, becomes the target of envy from fellow models, who all die mysteriously when they want to harm her. It turns out that when Anna is upset, she undergoes a terrifying transformation and can wield lethal psychic power...

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN's English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN's Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN's English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world's top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. Live debates linking movers and shakers take place in the signature segment "Global Debate".
